examiner_patterns.occ: Forward-looking projections, global cash flow with guarantors, sensitivity analysis depth
examiner_patterns.fdic: Historical trend documentation (3-5yr), DSCR calculation accuracy, repayment capacity
examiner_patterns.frb: Stress scenario rigor, industry cyclicality adjustment, counterparty credit risk
examiner_patterns.state: Repayment capacity fundamentals, documented sources of repayment

examiner_patterns.occ: Rating migration history, re-rating independence, accrual status tied to cash flow
examiner_patterns.fdic: Classification accuracy (Pass/SM/Sub/D/L), consistent application across portfolio
examiner_patterns.frb: Rating calibration at large banks, CAMELS asset quality component integration
examiner_patterns.state: Classification alignment with FDIC-Commissioner joint examinations

examiner_patterns.occ: Appraisal currency, USPAP compliance, independent MAI for larger credits
examiner_patterns.fdic: LTV calculation accuracy, lien position documentation, collateral valuation frequency
examiner_patterns.frb: LGD modeling for advanced approaches banks, wrong-way risk in collateral
examiner_patterns.state: Interagency Appraisal Guidelines compliance, evaluation vs appraisal determination

examiner_patterns.occ: Qualitative factor documentation, economic forecast support, reasonable and supportable period
examiner_patterns.fdic: Methodology validation, loss rate derivation, CECL implementation completeness
examiner_patterns.frb: Peer group comparison for large banks, advanced model validation, WARM method
examiner_patterns.state: Proportional application for smaller institutions, OK to use simplified approaches

examiner_patterns.occ: Covenant tracking quality, waiver governance, headroom analysis frequency
examiner_patterns.fdic: Covenant breach → downgrade discipline (avoid masking deterioration)
examiner_patterns.frb: Leveraged covenant-lite monitoring (though 2013 guidance withdrawn Dec 2025 for OCC/FDIC, Fed retains)
examiner_patterns.state: Standard covenant compliance, waiver documentation in Board minutes

examiner_patterns.occ: Credit agreement completeness, purpose clarity, approval authority documentation
examiner_patterns.fdic: Current financials (tax returns, audited statements), timely renewal, exception management
examiner_patterns.frb: Policy exception approval, Board-reviewed policy updates, enhanced at heightened-standards banks
examiner_patterns.state: Basic documentation — financials, appraisals, credit agreement, approval evidence

examiner_patterns.occ: Industry outlook analysis, competitive position, management track record
examiner_patterns.fdic: Management assessment with succession, key person risk, mitigants documentation
examiner_patterns.frb: Industry-specific stress factors, large corporate borrower depth
examiner_patterns.state: Local market conditions, borrower reputation in community

examiner_patterns.occ: Legal lending limit compliance, single-name concentration, CRE thresholds (100%/300%)
examiner_patterns.fdic: CRE concentration monitoring (31% of banks CRE-concentrated per 2025 Risk Review)
examiner_patterns.frb: Large exposure monitoring, counterparty credit risk (post-Archegos SR 21-19)
examiner_patterns.state: Community bank proportional concentration (relative to capital)

examiner_patterns.occ: DSCR stress at commitment, rate shock scenarios, borrower-level sensitivity
examiner_patterns.fdic: Portfolio-level stress for CRE-concentrated banks, revenue decline scenarios
examiner_patterns.frb: DFAST/CCAR for >$100B banks, enterprise-wide stress for SIFIs
examiner_patterns.state: Simplified stress acceptable for small banks; focus on rate shock and borrower-level

examiner_patterns.fdic: Independent loan review (internal or external) per Interagency Guidance 2020
examiner_patterns.frb: Internal audit vs credit review separation at large banks

examiner_patterns.occ: OCC Climate Principles Dec 2023 (>$100B banks); principles apply proportionally
